description: The supplied image is not a scientific figure. It is a small, low-resolution publisher badge — the Crossref "Check for updates" icon — with no axes, no units, no scale bar, no data, no panel labels and no caption. Visually it consists of a rounded light-grey button with a thin border. Inside the button, centred above the text, is a circular ring drawn as two thick arcs in pale blue and amber/yellow, and inside that ring a solid dark-red silhouette shaped like a bookmark or a page with a notched (swallow-tail) lower edge. Below the ring and above the button's lower border the words "Check for" sit on one line and "updates" on the next, set in a bold dark sans-serif typeface. There is no panel decomposition to perform, because the artwork contains a single graphic element rather than multiple sub-figures. Consequently this group carries zero materials-science information about the low-density high-strength FeeMneAleC steel, its hot deformation at 900-1150 °C and strain rates 0.01-10 s−1, its flow-stress curves, or its dynamic-recrystallization activation energy, critical/peak/steady-state strains and stresses. It is almost certainly an artefact: the image was cropped from the article's page furniture or a reference-manager record instead of from a figure, or the figure image failed to be captured. No description of microstructure, phase, texture, or property can be drawn from it, and downstream agents should treat this group as containing no usable evidence.

Inside the circular ring is a solid dark-red silhouette shaped like a bookmark whose lower edge has a swallow-tail notch.
The image contains no axes, no axis labels, no units, no numeric values, no scale bar, no legend and no panel letters such as (a) or (b).

The image contains no micrograph, spectrum, diffraction pattern, curve, map, table, schematic or photograph of a specimen, so it conveys no information about the alloy's microstructure or hot-deformation behaviour.
The image is rendered at low resolution and small size; the text glyphs are legible but slightly soft, and no other content is present that could be illegible.
No caption was extracted for this group, and nothing in the image itself identifies a sample, condition or figure number.
